_comment: Rich Presence configuration for Obsidian. Place this file in your vault root as rich-presence.json

largeIcon._comment_type: Type can be 'url', 'asset', or 'key'. 'url' = external image URL. 'asset' = path to image file inside vault. 'key' = Discord asset key name.

smallIcon._comment_type: Small icon shown over the large icon. Usually project/vault-specific.
smallIcon._comment_fallback: Emoji shown in tooltip if no icon is provided

variables._comment: You can define custom variables to use in display strings as {custom.my_var}

fileTypeIcons._comment: Map file extensions to custom icon keys/URLs for the small icon.

_comment_updateInterval: How often to refresh the presence in seconds. Minimum 15.
